title: PA HART hoist mission
description: The Pennsylvania Helicopter Aquatic Rescue Team performs a hoist mission from a UH-60 Black Hawk Helicopter with the 28th Expeditionary Combat Aviation Brigade, 28th Infantry Division, in Lehigh County, Pennsylvania, May 17, 2025. The Lehigh Emergency Services Training Academy provides highly specialized aerial search and rescue team and for the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and the nation in responding to manmade, natural, and incidents. (U.S. Army National Guard video by Cadet Jessica Barb)
keywords: UH-60 Black Hawk Helicopter, hoist mission, Pennsylvania Helicopter Aquatic Rescue Team, 28th Expeditionary Combat Aviation Brigade
